title: See, Explain, and Intervene: A Few-Shot Multimodal Agent Framework for Hateful Meme Moderation
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hateful content targeting Muslims, as part of a broader hateful meme detection task.
findings: The analysis of word patterns associated with hateful predictions revealed that the term 'muslims' was identified as a keyword in memes classified as hateful, indicating the models were tested on and can detect hate speech targeting this religious group.
